answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using optical physical unclonable functions. Agents authenticate by querying a physical tag containing a photoluminescent pigment deposited on a micro-etched silicon ridge. Probing the tag across an optical bridge yields stochastic scattering that cannot be simulated, forcing adversaries to incur the fabrication cost of dedicated micro-optical hardware per identity. However, gradual photobleaching from read cycles degrades the tag over time.
